scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run --cwd apps/kimi-code build
scripts.build:packages: for d in packages/*; do [ -f "$d/package.json" ] || continue; case "$(basename "$d")" in kap-server|minidb) continue;; esac; (cd "$d" && bun run build) || exit 1; done
scripts.typecheck: for d in packages/* apps/kimi-code; do [ -f "$d/package.json" ] || continue; case "$(basename "$d")" in kap-server|minidb) continue;; esac; (cd "$d" && bun run typecheck) || exit 1; done
scripts.lint:pkg: bun run --cwd apps/kimi-code exec publint && bun run --cwd apps/kimi-code exec attw --pack . --profile node16
scripts.clean: for d in packages/* apps/*; do [ -f "$d/package.json" ] || continue; (cd "$d" && bun run clean) 2>/dev/null || true; done
